description: The provider publishes measurements and CFD outputs used in research on drinking-water ozone and ultraviolet treatment. Fourteen native items describe ozone systems, single-lamp and baffled UV systems, bench-scale reactors and reactor design. Movie descriptors visualise particles, dose, dye and chemical predictions from the same research. These presentations remain components of the grouped dataset. Coverage: Individual native time-coverage fields and dates apply separately; no common interval is imposed. Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: NetCDF arrays, images or videos. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: Movies are not counted as additional datasets. Spatial and temporal resolution, a common sampling resolution and model accuracy are not established by these short descriptions. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
